newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real closed flat at 1.0626 per dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The forex spot market virtually ignored a cut in financial transaction taxes on foreign investments, with traders saying more time was needed to digest the measures.
"Everybody is waiting to get a better idea about the measures," one trader said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real also closed unchanged at 1.0676 per dollar.

Some brokers expect an increase in the floating market turnover in coming days due to the tariff cut to two percent from seven percent on financial transactions through non-resident CC5 acounts, which are carried out in this market.
In the parallel market, the real dropped 0.18 percent to close at 1.137 per dollar, traders said.
